decisions.text: importRuleset: a nested params object that is present but not an object falls back to the default copy; a non-object value is kept as-is for leaf params
importRuleset: a card whose cost is missing or not an object gets cost {C:0,N:0}; non-number cost C/N and copies are coerced to 0 instead of rejecting the file
defaultRuleset kept as written except the return value is structuredClone(ruleset), so each call returns a fresh deep copy
Interpretation texts follow Appendix A wording; I15 reads the PDF's Algae/Biofilm token as an alive algae card that a snail or grazer can eat; I9 notes the dropped 'opponent's' wording
Commit carries the Co-Authored-By attribution line from the session reminder after the requested subject line
